description.value: Banzai Sushi House is a Japanese sushi restaurant located in a strip mall unit on Westminster Highway in Richmond, operated as a division of Samurai Cambie. The menu spans nigiri, sashimi, donburi, udon, tempura, and an extensive roster of specialty and classic rolls, with party trays available via advance telephone order. It sits across from the Richmond Public Market, placing it in a busy retail hub convenient for cyclists passing through the area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (covered) at 69m; rack at 95m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is operational, provides a full address matching OSM, and explicitly advertises telephone takeout ordering. The menu lists several clearly vegetarian items (Kappa Roll, Avocado Roll, Vegetable Roll, Yam Tempura Roll, Edamame, Wakame Salad) providing positive evidence for that amenity. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website shows 604-821-0355 — phone added from website, not OSM.
OSM address field omits unit number and postal code; website-sourced full address (#40-8251 Westminster Hwy, Richmond BC. V6X 1A7) used instead.
Website copyright dated 2008 — site appears functional but may not be actively maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active sushi restaurant with telephone takeout service, located near the Richmond Public Market — a practical food stop for touring cyclists. Vegetarian roll options provide utility for varied dietary needs.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian items: Kappa Roll (Cucumber), Avocado Roll, Vegetable Roll, Yam Tempura Roll, Yam Cheese Roll, Edamame, Wakame Salad, Miso Soup. No vegan or GF labelling found

wow_evidence: strip mall unit on Westminster Highway in Richmond

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Most rolls $3.75–$8.35; sashimi orders $11.95–$31; donburi $21.95; typical meal $15–25/person
